notes.subject: מרעיתך
notes.rationale: Hebrew מרעית is 'pasturage/flock', rendered 'bilong gaden yu' (of your pasture)

notes.subject: danisim
notes.rationale: נודה from ידה, 'throw/cast toward' in worship — Tok Pisin 'danisim' (dance/praise-worship) closest to the reverent physical act

notes.subject: לדר ודר
notes.rationale: repetition dor wa-dor, generation and generation, kept as 'olresse… i go long olresse'

notes.subject: תהלתך
notes.rationale: 'ol krai bilong yu' — could also be 'ol singsing bilong yu' (hymns); תהלה is laudation/hymn

translation: Na mipela i stap ol man bilong yu, na ol sipsip na meme bilong gaden yu, bai mipela danisim ⟨את⟩ yu, olesm oltaim, long olresse ol liklik bilong man i go long olresse; mipela bai storyim ⟨את⟩ ol krai bilong yu.

tokens.gloss: long olresse ol liklik bilong man
